info.title: Kling 4.0 Image Generation Task - Query Tasks
info.description: Query Kling 4.0 image generation task status via `/kling/tasks`. Supports batch queries by system task ID or custom task ID. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); task results do not return these types yet.

get.description: Query Kling 4.0 image generation task status via `/kling/tasks`. Only non-realtime/asynchronous tasks are supported. Note: The platform does not yet integrate elements (`element`) or voices (`voice`); task results do not return these types yet.

parameters.name: task_ids
parameters.description: System task IDs to query. Use exactly one of `task_ids` or `external_task_ids`, never both. Batch queries are supported; separate multiple IDs with commas.

parameters.name: external_task_ids
parameters.description: Custom task IDs to query. Use exactly one of `task_ids` or `external_task_ids`, never both. Batch queries are supported; separate multiple IDs with commas.

bearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

type.description:
Result type. Returned fields vary by content type.

Note: `element` and `voice` result types are not yet integrated and are not returned yet.

id.description: Result ID generated by the system (returned for video, audio, voice, and element results).

url.description: URL of the generated result in anti-hotlinking format. Generated images and videos are cleaned up after 30 days, so save them promptly.

watermark_url.description: Download URL of the watermarked result in anti-hotlinking format.

group_id.description: Only present for series results; marks the grouping relationship.

status.description: Task status: submitted, processing, succeeded, or failed.

message.description: Task status message. When the task fails, the failure reason is returned (for example, content moderation).

create_time.description: Task creation time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

update_time.description: Task update time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

external_id.description: Custom task ID of this task, if any.

billing.description: Returned as multiple entries when the task consumes balances of multiple account types.

charge_type.description: Account type consumed: `cash` for balance, `unit` for resource packages.

cash_type.description: Balance type, only for charge_type=cash: `balance` (paid balance), `test_balance` (test credits), or `reward_balance` (reward credits).

amount.description: Deducted amount. For cash it is the discounted balance deduction; for unit it is the credit deduction. Decimal value.

package_type.description: Resource package type, only for charge_type=unit.

list_price.description: List price of the balance deduction, only for charge_type=cash.

code.description: Error code; 0 means success. See the error code documentation for details.

request_id.description: Request ID generated by the system for tracking and troubleshooting.

data.description: List of task results; multiple entries are returned for batch queries.
